I will manage this small plot in the simple way I know and can afford. Here in Kigoma, on a mixed plot like this, I mostly depend on local seed, family work, and a little manure if I can get it, because chemical inputs cost money. I do not plan to irrigate or spray this plot, and I will not hire much outside help.
